description: Hand a task from one agent to another (both owned by the caller). Required: to_agent_id. Optional: from_agent_id (default: the acting agent), task_todo_id, message. to_agent_id/from_agent_id take the agent id from list_agents OR its exact name (e.g. 'Termin-Assistent', case-insensitive), resolved only within this tenant; an unknown or ambiguous name is refused with the list of available agents (name = id). Without task_todo_id a one-time task is created for the receiver: it shows above the input of every Dev-Agent slot running that agent and under Delegations → Zwischen Agenten, and in the receiver's next run. If the receiver is a server-job agent (trigger_mode server_job) it is STARTED IMMEDIATELY (result: started=true) and works the task itself; otherwise a connected runner picks it up automatically if the tenant enabled automatic handoffs (limited per hour, last 24 hours only), else when someone clicks it there. Tell the person 'handed to <agent>', never 'done', until the receiver confirms. Put everything the receiver needs into message, including where to send the result. The receiving agent's own permissions still apply. wait_for_result=true: the receiver is started right away (max 5 per hour per sender), reports back with report_task_result, and the result automatically RESUMES THIS SESSION (in a Dev-Agent session) — also after a 24 h timeout. Until then give the human nothing about it; present only the final result (delegate_to_user). Use get_delegation_status to look at the state. nur_info=true: PURE INFORMATION for the receiver (an FYI, nothing to do) — stored as already finished (status info), no task, never started, does not wake a scheduled/takt agent; the receiver sees it in its bootstrap (infoUebergaben). Use it whenever the receiver need not act; a normal handoff costs the receiver a full run.

message.description: Everything the receiving agent needs, including where to send the result

nur_info.description: Information only: no task, no start, does not wake the receiver.

session_name.description: Name of the sending session to resume with the result

wait_for_result.description: Start the receiver now and resume this session with its result.

name: delegate_task
